== Description ==

[[Barry Alperstein]] (left, olive MORDOR graphic tee, beard, looking at cards) and [[Nathan Davis]] (mid-right, back to camera, navy GRIFFEY 24 Mariners jersey) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
